units.source_text: “那时，真的，任你怎样‘清沙’，根本就赶不上。

en.t: Back then, truly, no matter how much you cleared away the sand, you simply could not keep up.

units.source_text: 我丈夫说了声鸡窝有危险，就和读中学的女儿一起赶了过去……

en.t: My husband said the chicken coop was in danger, and hurried over there with our daughter, who was in middle school...

units.source_text: 我有我的事，我得看住正房吧……

en.t: I had my own things to do; I had to keep watch over the main house...

units.source_text: 就这么一去不归，好容易挨到天亮，风也小了，

en.t: They went off like that and never came back; at last I endured until dawn, and the wind had died down too,

units.source_text: 我赶过去一看，鸡窝连个影子都没有了……”

en.t: when I rushed over and looked, there was not even a trace of the chicken coop left..."
